reviewSamples.author: Kevin Worthen
reviewSamples.text: They were hired to put in a new outlet, and everything went well. The electrician knew what he was doing and made sure it was done right. The installation looks great when it's done. Very strongly suggested.

reviewSamples.author: Mary Simpson
reviewSamples.text: From start to finish, the service was done quickly and well. The electrician showed up on time and took some time to look into the problem. They told me about the work and answered my questions before they started. I liked how polite they were and how dedicated they were to doing a good job.

reviewSamples.author: Glenn Obrien
reviewSamples.text: We phoned this staff in the morning after our kitchen had a total partial power loss. An electrician arrived within an hour and located a burned-out outlet box wire. A competent technician performed the repair safely and swiftly.

reviewSamples.author: Joan Barclay
reviewSamples.text: Happy with the electrical work that was done. The technician was really pleasant, understood his stuff and was easy to deal with.

reviewSamples.author: Barbara McDonald
reviewSamples.text: Excellent work, all around! The installation of the light fixtures went really well, and I would certainly suggest them to anyone looking for quality service. They were punctual and efficient, completing the project in just one day!
